main_text.p: vel obijciant, in medium afferant, poftea autem auditis & assentiétib.(nifi ad maiorem senatum negotium deferri fuerit necesse, ad turbas vitandas siue componendas, quod tum cum maior pars ecclesiæ dissentiat faciendum est) decernenda & pro decretis ecclesijs proponenda sunt.(a)1.Cor.12.28.1.Tim. 4.2.Reg.6.32.Deut.17.9.(b)2.Cro.30.23. Act.1.15.23. 26.Act.6.1.2.1.Cor.5.4.2.Cor.2.6.7.

Hæc autem maioris momenti negotia, sunt; inter censuras, excommunicatio, eiusq; absolutio: in coetu totius ecclesiæ authoritate facienda, leges maximi momenti constituendæ, controuersiæ fidei componendæ, ministrorum electiones & abdicationes iustæ,& cætera his æqua vel maiora. 2.Cro.30. 23. Act.14.23. 1.Cor. 5. 2.Cor. 2.6.7. Act. 15.1.2.3.4. 2.Ti.5.17.18.19.20.21.& Ac.11.2.3.Ac.15.2.Ac.15.22.

p.i: Atqį hæc de ipsis negotijs & authoritate qua gerenda sunt.

main_text.head: Sequuntur presbyterij officij partes, erga seipsos.
main_text.p: Erga seipsos, est officium mutuum in mutuo bono præstando.
Confilia, quibus se mutuò promouent & diriguntt.Act.21.18.19.20.21.22.Act.8.14.
Censuræ quibus in se mutuo inquirunt, & admonent, prout opus fuerit, in omnibus muneris siue partibus

page.notes: Printed page is a left page with a fragment of the facing page at the right edge; the bracketed mixed sequence "Sequuntur presbyterij ... seipsos" and the brace diagram are set in the printed layout and are reproduced as best readable. Marginal letters (a), (b) are in the text. Several lines of the brace diagram (Confilia / Censurae, and "exsequentur") are doubtful in their exact placement.
